summary: iHuman Inc., a NYSE-listed Chinese edtech firm, filed a Form 6-K announcing the acquisition of businesses and assets related to the All Knowledge and Perfect Lingo apps. The aggregate consideration is RMB94.0 million (approx. $13M), subject to two-way price adjustments and contingent earn-out payments. The transaction will expand iHuman's product portfolio into AI-powered humanities and language learning. No board recommendation, advisor, or specific close date is mentioned. Post-closing, Teng Li will be appointed Co-CEO. This is a strategic bolt-on acquisition to broaden market reach and AI capabilities. Watch for closing conditions and integration risks given the AI-focused assets.
